sources.entry: tweakcc by Piebald-AI - Command-line tool to customize your Claude Code installation: themes, thinking verbs, spinners, and input-box styling, plus deeper tweaks like custom toolsets, system-prompt edits, input pattern highlighters, and AGENTS.md support. Works against both native and npm installs.

summary.one_liner: tweakcc is a command-line tool that customizes a Claude Code installation by patching its code with themes, thinking verbs, spinners, system prompts, toolsets, and other UI and behavior tweaks.
summary.what_it_does: The tool reads customizations from a local config file (~/.tweakcc/config.json) and patches Claude Code's JavaScript, which it does for both npm installs (cli.js directly) and native Bun binaries (extracted, patched, and repacked via node-lief). It offers an interactive TUI (npx tweakcc) for themes, thinking verbs and spinner animations, input box styling, and user message display. System prompt parts are stored as editable markdown files in ~/.tweakcc/system-prompts and applied with --apply. Toolsets limit which built-in tools are sent to the model, and the /toolset command switches between them. The README also describes adhoc-patch for one-off string, regex, or sandboxed JavaScript patches, unpack/repack for native binaries, a --restore option, a Remote Config option to apply a config from a URL, and an npm API.
use_cases: customize Claude Code colors and themes
limit which tools Claude Code can call
change thinking verbs and spinner animation
apply custom patches to a Claude Code binary
share a Claude Code config via a gist or URL
highlight patterns in the Claude Code input box
stack: node-lief (LIEF bindings for native binary patching)
notable: Patches both native Bun executables and npm-based Claude Code installs, across Windows, macOS, and Linux
System prompts are editable markdown files, with conflict resolution and HTML diffs when Anthropic changes them
Toolsets remove tools from the model's prompt entirely, not just from permissions
adhoc-patch runs sandboxed Node scripts with --experimental-permission, and can load them from URLs
Includes an npm API for use in other projects
caveats: Verified against Claude Code 2.1.162 only; other versions may have patches that fail, though system prompt patching is said to work with any version that has prompt data
Patches are overwritten on Claude Code updates and must be reapplied with --apply
adhoc-patch does not create a backup, so --apply must be run first if restore is needed
